title: Rate limit the public API per key

change.title: Rate limit the public API per key

proposals.title: Send Retry-After with the 429
proposals.body: Clients can't back off correctly without it.

proposals.title: The limit should be per plan, not a constant
proposals.body: Enterprise keys get 1,000/min in the pricing page.

proposals.title: Use a fixed error shape
proposals.body: Other errors return `{ error: { code, message } }`.

decisions.note: mention the plan table in billing/plans.ts
we're changing the error shape next quarter anyway
